text:
Ava (People Ops): FYI team 1: We're piloting a small "handback escalation" flow for spring reviews to handle staggered deadlines + regional holidays. Posting the CSV template and a short checklist here.
Devon (Eng Manager): Awesome. Can this cover both reviewer and manager handback delays? We have one case where the reviewer handed back but manager hasn't completed rating.
Ava (People Ops): Yes 1: two modes: reviewer-extension and manager-handback-extension. The CSV includes a mode column.
Nora (Calibration Lead): Important: calibration chairs want an appendix in the packet listing all extended items with flags and audit IDs. Otherwise medians break.
Samir (IC): Quick question 1: if I submitted on time but my manager gets marked late because of an extension, will that affect my promotion eligibility metrics?
Ava (People Ops): No. We attach an immutable extension flag and keep individual submission timestamps unchanged. Promotion-eligibility logic ignores items with extension flags; chairs are shown both raw and normalized views.
Ava (People Ops): CSV template (paste into a file called handback_escalations.csv):
```
mode,manager_email,reviewer_email,reviewee_email,form_id,reason_short,approved_by,approval_ts,expected_resolution_date
manager-handback,devon@redwood.ai,na,samir@redwood.ai,form_55321,manager traveling,Nora,2026-04-01T11:05:00Z,2026-04-06
reviewer-extension,lin@redwood.ai,amelia@redwood.ai,amelia@redwood.ai,form_55388,medical LOA,Devon,2026-04-02T09:20:00Z,2026-04-10
```
Ava (People Ops): Operational notes: 1) Send CSV to people-ops@redwood.ai 2) Ops will run a scoped job that:  - applies extension flags (immutable)  - adds an audit entry with ID prefixed HBX-  - updates team dashboard and creates an appendix in the calibration packet 3) Job returns a small JSON report with audit IDs and rows applied (we keep the report internal).
Devon (Eng Manager): What's the turnaround SLA?
Ava (People Ops): Standard SLA is 4 hours during business hours, 24 hours otherwise. If you're in an urgent region ping @Ava directly.
Nora (Calibration Lead): Chairs request two extra fields in the appendix: "promotion-impact" (yes/no) and "chair_note" so we can mark items that should be excluded from strict ranking. Can you include those in the job output?
Ava (People Ops): Yes 1: we'll include those columns in the appendix export. Managers, when submitting, please annotate promotion-impact conservatively.
ops-bot: System: deadline enforcement run at 2026-03-31T23:59:00Z (global). Manual extension jobs require People Ops approval token.
Samir (IC): Thanks 1: submitted my on-time timestamp is still visible. Good to know.
Devon (Eng Manager): Sending CSV now with 3 items. Will note promotion-impact for the sensitive ones.
Ava (People Ops): Received. We'll run the job and post audit IDs here when done. Also adding a short how-to to the review ops doc page so managers can self-serve next cycle.
Ava (People Ops): Job complete 1: applied 3 rows. Audit IDs: HBX-3001, HBX-3002, HBX-3003. Appendix added to the calibration packet under "manual_extensions_april_2026.csv".
Nora (Calibration Lead): Received appendix. Chairs will treat items with promotion-impact=yes as "review with context" and exclude from median rank if needed.
Devon (Eng Manager): All handbacks resolved for my team, thanks.
Ava (People Ops): Closing thread 1: will link the how-to doc and the CSV template in the review ops page. If anyone needs a UI hint for next cycle, file a small product request with "handback badge" in the title.
